# AMS Prime Egypt For Trading and Export

> Export trading house in Dokki, Giza, Egypt, founded in 2026. Supplies importers, distributors and procurement teams, mainly in Kuwait, plus Saudi Arabia and the UAE. Nine product ranges. Quotations on request; no published prices.

- Trade registration: 8272768, Cairo Investment Office
- CEO: Ali Muhammed Saheer
- Email: info@amsprimeegypt.com
- WhatsApp: +20 150 538 9954
- Export documents: certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate, certificate of analysis, invoice and packing list, bill of lading, fumigation certificate where required
